name: Livingstone Office for Contemporary Arts (LoCA)
known: Founded in 2014 by Anawana Haloba and Victor Mutelekesha, with a network of artists and curators from across the African diaspora including Gabi Ngcobo and Milumbe Haimbe (ArtReview, Chaze Matakala, "Who Builds Zambia's Art World?", 19 January 2026).

name: Lusaka Contemporary Art Centre (LuCAC)
known: Founded by Victor Mutelekesha, a Zambian artist based in Oslo.

The inaugural exhibition "Prospice, Kwacha!", curated by Karen Reini, ran from 6 January to 17 December 2023 with Banji Chona, Sana Ginwalla, Daut Makala and Germain Ngoma (Art Africa, Nkwazi Magazine).

name: National Gallery of Zimbabwe
known: Raphael Chikukwa is executive director and Fadzai Muchemwa is curator (Wikipedia).

In November 2022 Minister Kirsty Coventry of the Ministry of Youth, Sport, Arts and Recreation appointed Justice Maphios Cheda (Rtd) chair of the gallery's Board of Trustees, under the Public Entities and Corporate Governance Act (Business Times, 20 November 2022).

name: Nhaka Gallery (formerly Gallery Delta)
known: The same article says the address was Gallery Delta until 2022 and that Delta's founders "helped young artists learn their craft, get international exposure, and launch their careers".
